title: The game's glows, with the right arguments
intro: Stand next to your main pawn, camera on them. Press End to start.

steps.text: Look at your MAIN PAWN (close, camera on them). 7 of the game's glows follow, 4 s each, A to G. Press End when they're in view.

steps.each_frame:
local function rm()
  local ch = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'):call('get_PawnCharacterList'):call('get_Item', 0)
  return ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('getComponent(System.Type)', sdk.typeof('app.MaterialInterpolationRequestManager'))
end
local function hash(n) return sdk.find_type_definition('app.MIRimLightHash'):get_field(n):get_data(nil) end
local SIG_ON = 'requestMaterialMode(System.UInt32, app.MaterialInterpolationRequestManager.RequestListCategory, System.Int32, System.Int32)'
local SIG_OFF = 'finishMaterialMode(System.UInt32, app.MaterialInterpolationRequestManager.RequestListCategory, System.Int32, System.Int32)'
local function set(n, on) local m = rm(); pcall(m.call, m, on and SIG_ON or SIG_OFF, hash(n), 8, -1, -1) end
if G_g ~= 'A' then G_g = 'A'; set('PawnRimStone', true) end
